name: Hardened Tumor
summary: Forsaken researchers seek a Hardened Tumor for their work on the New Plague. Apothecary Berard first studied the growth before Arugal's curse made him a mindless servant.

sections.title: A Rare Biological Anomaly
sections.body: Along Lake Lordamere, Vile Fin murlocs sometimes develop a rare, calcified growth. Apothecary Berard recorded the abnormality while studying wildlife along Silverpine Forest's eastern borders. The growth appears only in mature specimens along the shoreline and the Dawning Isles. Its cause remains uncertain, but the Royal Apothecary Society took notice of the dense tissue.

sections.title: Fuel for the New Plague
sections.body: After Arugal's curse left Berard a mindless servant, his journal was recovered from Pyrewood Village and taken to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher. Renferrel saw promise in Berard's work and sent Forsaken agents to retrieve a Hardened Tumor and native aquatic mosses. Master Apothecary Faranell oversees the Apothecarium in the Undercity, where he seeks reagents that can resist decay or alter biological matter. He added the growth to the Society's ongoing work on the New Plague.

faq.answer: A Hardened Tumor is a rare, abnormal calcified mass that forms inside Vile Fin murlocs around Lake Lordamere. Apothecary Berard discovered it, and it resists ordinary physical decay and has unusual biological properties.

faq.q: Why does the Royal Apothecary Society want it?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society gathers unusual toxic and biological specimens to make the New Plague. Master Apothecary Faranell considers the tumor's resilience and cellular makeup a candidate for blight experiments.
Vile Fin murlocs in Silverpine Forest carry these tumors, including those near the Dawning Isles in eastern Lake Lordamere and along the village shores northeast of Ambermill.

Apothecary Berard was a Royal Apothecary Society apothecary stationed in Silverpine Forest. Arugal's curse made him a mindless servant in Pyrewood Village. Berard researched local flora, fauna, and murloc mutations, and uncovered the utility of the Dawning Isles' mosses and hardened tumors.

angles.text: As an Undead, you help advance Master Apothecary Faranell's research into the New Plague, serving Lady Sylvanas and the Forsaken's struggle against living and undead adversaries.
